messages:
Ethan: Hi team — first day. Can't see Redwood-Onboarding Wi‑Fi in network list, only Redwood-Guest. I'm on MacBook Air. Anyone know if profiles need to be pre-provisioned?

it-support: Welcome Ethan! We push certificates via mobileconfig. Is your laptop enrolled in Intune? Check System Settings > Profiles. If not enrolled, try the self-serve link: https://go.redwood.internal/onboard

Ethan: Profiles shows nothing. I clicked self-serve but it errors with 'device not recognized'. I'm remote in Oakland and used my personal hotspot to sign in.

it-bot: New IT ticket #46012 created: "Onboarding Wi-Fi certificate not applied / onboarding portal error" assigned to it-support.

it-support: Hmm. Can you run `profiles status` and paste the short output? Also which browser did you use to open the portal? Sometimes Safari blocks third-party cookies.

Ethan: mac, ran `profiles status` — returns 'No profiles installed'. Used Chrome.

it-support: Ok. Two quick things: 1) try Safari and accept cookies; 2) if still failing, we can put a temporary Guest+VPN allow so you can finish installs and I'll push the cert via DEP. For now use your hotspot. Also, front desk has your SF welcome kit ready if you want to swing by and pick up a spare ethernet dongle. @frontdesk can confirm pickup hours.

frontdesk: @Ethan hi — front desk SF open 9-5. We have a labeled kit 'ETHAN-KIT-01' at reception. If you come by, bring ID and we'll hand it over. If remote, we can ship next-day.

Ethan: I'm remote, but might be in SF next week. Please ship if Intune can't enroll today.

it-support: We'll try remote push first. If portal keeps failing, we'll ship. ETA for shipping if needed: next business day. Keep screenshots of the portal error.

Ethan: Will do, thanks. One more Q — who should I ask about access to #platform-internal Slack? I clicked request but it's stuck in pending.

it-support: Ping @onboarding and we'll expedite once the device is enrolled. Ticket #46012 updated to in_progress.

Ethan: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
